title: [Suggestion]
body:
### Resource Name

Dimensional

### URL

https://dimensional.org/

### GitHub Repository

dimensionalOS/dimos

### Alternative Repository

_No response_

### Category

Robot Platform

### Description

An agentic operating system to build applications for humanoids, drones, quadrupeds and other hardwares in natural language. No ROS required.

### Why should it be included?

With an agent-native framework where the primary interface is natural language, Dimensional fills the gap between software and hardware and makes robotics accessible to more people.

Affiliation: I work on the Dimensional project. 

### Must-have checklist (all required)

- [x] Relevant to robotics (simulation, planning, perception, control, dynamics, etc.)
- [x] Publicly accessible (open source, or well-documented commercial tool)
- [x] Not a duplicate of an existing entry
- [x] Has a meaningful description

### Scoring checklist (need ≥ 3 of 5)

- [x] **Popularity**: ≥ 50 GitHub stars (or equivalent community adoption for non-GitHub projects)
- [x] **Activity**: At least one commit within the last 2 years
- [x] **Documentation**: Has a README with usage examples or API docs
- [x] **Maturity**: Project is ≥ 6 months old
- [x] **Uniqueness**: Fills a niche not already covered by existing entries
